lineWidth.$description: Stroke width of the timeline's connectors and end nodes.

badgeSize.$description: Diameter of each milestone's circular badge.

arcGap.$description: Space between a badge and the quarter arc that wraps it (arc radius = badge radius + arcGap).

nodeSize.$description: Diameter of the hollow node at the end of each connector stem.

nodeGap.$description: Space between a connector's end node and its milestone details.

stemMin.$description: Shortest vertical stem from an arc to its node in the horizontal layout.

stemMinInline.$description: Shortest horizontal stem from an arc to its node in the vertical layout.

columnMin.$description: Narrowest milestone column in the horizontal layout; narrower containers scroll.

rowGap.$description: Space between milestones in the vertical layout.

yearGap.$description: Space between a badge and its year label.
